articles.title: New PUC rates in Maharashtra: Check revised charges for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, four-wheelers, petrol and diesel vehicles
articles.description: Maharashtra PUC rates: Maharashtra's Transport Department has increased pollution certificate fees by twenty percent. Two-wheeler owners will now pay sixty rupees for their PUC certificates. Petrol three-wheeler and four-wheeler vehicle owners face new charges. Diesel vehicle owners will also pay a higher amount for their certificates. All PUC centers must now display the updated fee structure prominently.
